about.title: About AKAM Machine
about.intro: AKAM Machine began operating in 2019 (Iranian calendar: 1398) at Shahrud Industrial Estate, focusing on engineering design and the manufacture of industrial and mining machinery and equipment.
about.text: The company’s work includes engineering design, manufacturing industrial and mining machinery and equipment, custom production, and equipment refurbishment. Depending on each project, AKAM Machine works from requirement review and design through manufacturing, assembly, and quality control.
about.team: 10 permanent employees and approximately 25 project-based workers
about.outsourcingIntro: Depending on project requirements, certain specialist operations are assigned to specialist contractors.
